home.agent_picker.why: Pick the agent for this job. Sign in once, and it runs on any of your computers.
home.ask_box.placeholder_home: Describe a task. Type @ to pick a computer.
home.ask_box.label: What should it do?
home.ask_box.this_computer_note: Works on your own files and apps
home.ask_box.sign_in_failed_hint: Try again, or sign in from Settings, then Connections.
home.task.earlier_error: {name} couldn't show the earlier messages. You can still continue: {name} picks up its own session when you send.
home.task.imported_note: Nothing runs until you send. {name} then carries on this chat on {computer}, in its own folder.
home.task.session_not_yet: Not yet: the chat's session is on {computer}
home.task.offline: {count, plural, one {# more computer is offline.} other {# more computers are offline.}}
home.confirm.title: Work on {computer}?
home.confirm.description: {agent} will use your own files and apps, without asking before each step. You can't throw this computer away afterwards.
home.start_error.not_shared_title: {computer} isn't set up for tasks yet
home.start_error.not_shared_body: Turn on sharing for {computer} on its page in Computers, then try again. Or pick another computer.
home.start_error.cant_start_here_body: Try again to start it on {computer}, or pick another computer.
home.start_error.gone_title: That computer is no longer available
home.start_error.gone_body: Cua Cloud has ended. Pick a computer on {computer} instead.
home.start_error.ambiguous_title: More than one computer has that name
home.start_error.not_found_body: It may have been deleted or renamed. Pick another one.
home.start_error.key_body: Add it in Settings → Connections, then try again.
home.start_error.unreachable_body: Check it's on, then try again. Or pick another one.
home.start_error.host_unreachable_body: Cua Spaces on {computer} may have just restarted. Try again in a moment.
home.start_error.no_room_title: {computer} doesn't have room for a new computer
home.start_error.no_room_body: Free some disk space or turn off a computer you're not using, then try again.
home.start_error.failed_body: Something went wrong. Try again, pick another computer, or send us a report.
home.suggestion.tests_title: Run my project's tests on a clean Linux Space
home.suggestion.tests_prompt: Get my project, make a clean Linux Space for it, install what it needs and run its tests. Tell me what passed and what failed:
home.suggestion.pr_title: Try a pull request before merging
home.suggestion.pr_detail: Paste the PR link after it.
home.suggestion.pr_prompt: Check out this pull request, build it and run its tests, then tell me if it's safe to merge:
home.suggestion.safari_title: Check my site works on Safari
home.suggestion.safari_prompt: Make a macOS Space, open my site in Safari, click through the main pages and tell me what looks or works wrong:
home.repo.invalid: That is not a repo link. Try https://github.com/owner/name or owner/name.
home.task.not_here: This task isn't on this device.
home.task.controls: You have the controls. {name} waits until you hand it back.
home.task.throw_description: This deletes the computer and everything on it. This conversation stays here.
home.task.own_files: It works with your own files and apps.
home.task.usually_under_a_minute: Usually under a minute. The first one takes a few minutes.
home.task.report_failed: The report could not be prepared. Try again.
home.task.stuck_body: {name} hasn't done anything new for a while. You can nudge it with a reply, or take over the screen.
home.task.still_on: The computer is still on. Keep it or throw it away?
home.task.wont_ask: It won't ask before each step.
home.this_mac.add_failed: {computer} couldn't be added to your account.
